name: wblinv
expr: x_d = wblinv(0.5); x_dlo = wblinv(0.05); x_dhi = wblinv(0.95); x_d0 = wblinv(0); x_d1 = wblinv(1); x_dneg = wblinv(-0.1); x_dover = wblinv(1.5); x_w = wblinv(0.5, 2, 3); x_klt1 = wblinv(0.5, 1, 0.5); x_kgt1 = wblinv(0.5, 1, 2); x_v = wblinv(ps, 1, 2); x_a0 = wblinv(0.5, 0, 1); x_aneg = wblinv(0.5, -1, 1); x_b0 = wblinv(0.5, 1, 0); x_bneg = wblinv(0.5, 1, -1); x_nan = wblinv(NaN, 1, 1); x_nan2 = wblinv(0.5, NaN, 1);
comment: Sig: x = wblinv(p[, a, b]). Inverse Weibull CDF: x = a · (-log(1-p))^(1/b). Defaults a=1, b=1 (= exponential -log(1-p)). p=0 -> 0; p=1 -> Inf; p outside [0,1] -> NaN; a<=0, b<=0 -> NaN; NaN -> NaN.
